admission.justification: The budget test bounds every fresh compiled capsule within its recorded budget; without it an overgrown capsule would silently break instruction composition. Registry totals are evidenced by the registry cells and the A8 decisions, not by the test.

applicability: All 38 role, operation and launcher capsule budgets in skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/capsule-budgets.json.
conditions: Each stored budget equals ceil(stored size_words * 11 / 10); fresh compiled sizes stay at or under budget, as checked by the budget test.
The current registry has 38 cells and its updates carry their decision record. Prior L101/A8 raw, adjusted and compiled totals remain dated evidence, not current-size guarantees.
exclusions: Historical era sums (62748, a1b7 109616, master 107226) and the dated A8 compiled total 93905 as current contract terms.
The L101 83786 raw and 82200 A8-adjusted totals as current contract terms.

evidence: capsule-sizes.json (era 62748, a1b7 109616, master 107226, final 93905); sync-check 9/9; F07 memo for launcher/orientation +57 and architect/recovery +17

statement: The 38-cell capsule-budget registry records current compiled capsule sizes with each budget equal to ceil(size_words*11/10), updated in the same change with its decisions; fresh compiled sizes stay within those budgets. Dated leaf totals are measurements, not reusable numeric contract terms.
